Ferry Announcer Style Scale

Instructions:  Below are several descriptions of the way the ferry announcer spoke. Use the following scale to rate the degree to which each statement applies.

Strongly Disagree	Disagree	Neutral	Agree	Strongly Agree
             1	    	      2 	 	     3 		    4 		           5

_____1. The announcer gave exact departure times.

_____2. The announcer cared whether we understood.

_____3. The announcer used tide tables to explain the delay.

_____4. The announcer listened to our questions.

_____5. The announcer did not give exact departure times.

_____6. The announcer did not care whether we understood.

_____7. The announcer did not use tide tables to explain the delay.

_____8. The announcer did not listen to our questions.

Scoring:

Reverse Code Items 5, 6, 7, & 7

Precise Factor:  1, 3, 5, 7

Caring Factor:  2, 4, 6, 8
